In this role, you support the cutters in the beef cutting room. - You provide the cutters with meat, a task also known as "throwing up," by tipping crates onto the cutting tables. - Operating meat processing machines such as a derinding machine, meatmaster, or slicer; - Performing weighing tasks; removing waste and supplying containers; cleaning tasks according to work instructions, often using a high-pressure hose; 
The start time at work is 06.00 am, and the end time is flexible. The work is usually an 8-hour shift, between Monday and Friday, but extra hours and extra days of the weekend are planned according to the operational needs. 
 Job Requirements 
 - You must be able to lift heavy crates, stand for extended periods, and have no other physical limitations. - You are flexible and willing to work overtime. - You speak English and/or Dutch. - You can work in a team and independently. - You are eager to learn and motivated to develop yourself. - You are able to work in a 7 degree environment. - You are available during peak periods (December and Easter). - Willingness to adhere to regulations regarding All visible jewelry, piercings, false nails/eyelashes, or nail polish, which are prohibited in food production environments. 
 Employment conditions 
 - €0,09 Allowance per hour, for working in 7 degree environment. - Annual December bonus of 3,25% of gross salary (with the condition of working at least 2 months in Luiten. - Employment contract with Charlie works. - Health Insurance. - Housing at a close distance. - Free electrical bike for transport to work paid by Luiten. - Friendly, multi-cultural,...
